name: Nahash
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabeshgilead, and all the men of Jabesh said, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee. Nahash answered, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel; he wanted to blind every man in one eye.

When Nahash king of the children of Ammon came against them, Israel said, Nay, but a king shall reign over us, when the Lord their God was their king. That demand exposed their disbelief in the Lord; they wanted a king they could see and touch, because all the nations around them had kings.

note.label: 1 Samuel 12: Turn Not Aside From Following the Lord
